description: This file defines the BlogPostListener class, which listens to blog post-related events (such as creation and deletion) and triggers feed updates accordingly within the Goteo application.

classes.name: BlogPostListener
classes.description: Event listener class for handling blog post creation and deletion events to generate feed updates.

methods.name: createFeed
methods.description: Creates activity feed entries for a new blog post, both for private (admin) and public views.

methods.name: onBlogPost
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a new blog post is created; initiates feed creation if published.

methods.name: onBlogDeleted
methods.description: Event handler triggered when a blog post is deleted; creates a deletion feed entry.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping application events to handler methods for subscription.
